Definition: to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie
BiblicalUsage: David says God sets his way free and makes it plain, and Habakkuk sees the LORD drive the nations asunder with a look as He marches through the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can loose what binds me and scatter what threatens me with the same power, opening the shut way and driving the nations asunder at a glance.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
